definition: Cleveland Fed nowcast of Core CPI month-over-month percent change, excluding food and energy.
notes: Primary direct predictor for Kalshi Core CPI MoM markets.

definition: Cleveland Fed nowcast of Core PCE month-over-month percent change, excluding food and energy.
notes: Fed-preferred core inflation gauge; useful related inflation context.

definition: Cleveland Fed nowcast of headline CPI month-over-month percent change, all items.
notes: Headline CPI includes food and energy; useful for broad inflation sentiment.

definition: Cleveland Fed nowcast of headline PCE month-over-month percent change.
notes: Useful related inflation context, less directly tied to the Kalshi Core CPI contract.

definition: West Texas Intermediate crude oil spot price, Cushing Oklahoma.
notes: More relevant to headline CPI than core CPI, but can affect inflation sentiment.

definition: Nominal broad U.S. dollar index against major trading partners.
notes: Dollar strength can affect import prices and broad macro conditions.

definition: Market yield on 10-year U.S. Treasury securities at constant maturity.
notes: Broad rates and growth/inflation expectations context.

definition: Market yield on 2-year U.S. Treasury securities at constant maturity.
Market-implied average inflation expectation over the next five years from Treasury/TIPS spreads.
Market-implied average inflation expectation over the next ten years from Treasury/TIPS spreads.
Market-implied five-year inflation expectation starting five years forward.
Producer Price Index for all commodities.
notes: Upstream price pressure; useful but not the exact BLS PPI release-surprise feed.

definition: Producer Price Index for final demand excluding foods and energy.
notes: Core upstream price pressure, potentially relevant for Core CPI expectations.

definition: Advance retail and food services sales.
Average hourly earnings of all employees, total private.
notes: Wage pressure context for services inflation.
